'''Rod Latham Ralltiir Kessel Run''' is a [[Light]] deck by [[Rod Latham]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/lst9.htm Ralltiir Kessel Run], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010228074212/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/lst9.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Rod Latham]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Special Edition]] (from the card pool)
* '''Published:''' [[Trandosite]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Event:''' [[February 1999 Bisley tournament]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|SE-L-hiddenbase.gif}}
* '''Played:''' Feb. 1999

== Introduction ==
Trandosite lists this as one of [[Rod Latham]]'s tournament decks: played 28th February 1999, 0 wins and 3 losses from 3 games (differential -30).<ref name="trandosite" />
